failure_summary.description: Agents used prohibited imports or left result-producing calls bare, duplicated, or unsaved.
Agents failed to update suitable cached results or complete an earlier pending deliverable.
Agents omitted explicit cuisine preferences or mapped an exact rating to a minimum threshold.
An agent parsed an explicitly provided date and conditionally rejected it based on the current date.

patch.reasoning: The existing skill already directly requires saving every result, avoiding imports and speculative date calculations, resolving pending work from the full conversation, updating suitable cached results, and mapping single numeric ratings exactly. These failures reflect noncompliance with existing guidance, so adding duplicate rules is not warranted.
